message.content: Good morning. I am stuck on the ZUS ZWUA form for the heritage society. I cannot find the correct box for 'volunteer work' versus 'paid employment'. It is making my eyes hurt.

content.text: Good morning, Krzysztof. For volunteer work at a heritage society where you do not receive a salary, you should leave the employment section blank or select 'no employment' if prompted. You only need to fill in the personal data section and the insurance period if you have any. Do you need help locating the specific fields for your personal details?

message.content: Yes, please. I want to make sure I do not put anything in the salary boxes. I have no salary. Just the pension.

content.text: Understood. Since you are receiving a pension, ensure that the section regarding 'basis of insurance' indicates that you are already insured via your pension. You do not need to report any earnings. If the form asks for the 'subject of insurance,' select 'volunteer activity' if available, or simply do not declare any new employment subject. Would you like me to summarize the exact steps for the personal data section?

message.content: That would be helpful. I always worry I will forget a number.

content.text: Certainly. For the personal data section, you will need your PESEL number, which is already in your system. You will need to enter your full name, address exactly as it appears on your ID, and your phone number. The key is to ensure the 'employment' section remains empty or marked as non-applicable for this specific volunteer role. Does your heritage society provide a reference number for the volunteer agreement? Sometimes that goes in the notes section.

message.content: I do not think so. They just said I am helping out. Is that enough? I do not want to fill out a whole new contract.

content.text: That is usually sufficient for informal volunteer assistance. As long as no money changes hands, you are not considered an employee. You can simply leave the employment declaration part blank. Just double-check that you have ticked the box indicating you are already covered by pension insurance. If you are unsure about the specific checkbox for 'already insured,' I can describe the standard option for pensioners.

message.content: Yes, please describe it. I am looking at the screen now.

content.text: Look for the section titled 'Basis of Insurance' or 'Subject of Insurance.' There should be a checkbox or option that says 'Pension' or 'Already Insured.' Select that one. Do not select 'Employment Contract' or 'Civil Law Contract.' This tells ZUS that you do not need new health or retirement contributions because they are already deducted from your pension. Does that match what you see?

message.content: I see it. It says 'Pension.' I will click that. Thank you. It is simpler than I thought.

content.text: You are welcome, Krzysztof. It is easy to overcomplicate these forms. Just remember to save the document before you submit it, and perhaps take a photo of the confirmation page for your records. Is there anything else regarding the paperwork you need help with?

message.content: No, that is all. I will go make tea now.

content.text: Enjoy your tea. Feel free to reach out if you have more questions about the form later.
